verdict.rationale: Netlify's own docs say users can prompt AI agents from the Netlify dashboard to fix, update, and ship code using project context. Users can also start new projects by describing them to an AI agent, with saved prompt templates for the team. This directly covers delegating tasks to an in-product assistant. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the agent's capabilities, limits, and review/approval flow; independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Prompt AI agents to fix, update, and ship code using your unique project context directly from your Netlify dashboard.
Describe what you want to build. An AI agent handles the rest.
Start a new project with an AI agent, a Git repository, or drag and drop.
Explore curated Prompt Templates that you can customize and save for your Netlify team's use.
